one_liner: Shopify offers a broad GraphQL (plus legacy REST) Admin API with OAuth2 for multi-merchant apps, free Partner accounts and dev stores; only an official dev-docs MCP exists, store-operating MCPs are community.
auth_notes: Authorization code grant, token exchange, and client credentials grant are supported. Merchant-created custom apps give a static Admin API access token (shpat_) sent in X-Shopify-Access-Token. Expiring offline tokens are required for new apps from Dec 2026.
access_notes: A free Partner account and free development stores work as a sandbox. Some scopes, such as Shopify Payments and protected customer data, need Shopify approval. Public distribution needs app review.
blocker_notes: Some scopes, such as protected customer data and payments, need Shopify approval. Public app distribution needs review. Neither blocks a toolkit.

evidence.quote: Token Exchange - Recommended for embedded apps. Authorization Code Grant Flow - Suitable for non-embedded apps. Client Credentials Grant - Suitable for backend apps without UI
authenticates requests with a token sent in the `X-Shopify-Access-Token` header.
you can test out the APIs for free using a partner account that gives you access to development stores that you can use as a sandbox.
Shopify approval required Shopify has to approve your app for the scope before you can declare it.
Most Shopify APIs, including the GraphQL Admin API, Storefront API, and Partner API, authenticate your app acting on behalf of a merchant or organization.
An MCP (Model Context Protocol) server that gives AI agents full access to the Shopify Admin API.
Run the following command to start the Shopify dev MCP server: npx -y @shopify/dev-mcp@latest
